title: John of Antioch, Historia chronica (fragments); «Хроника» Иоанна Антиохийского
author: John of Antioch
genre: World chronicle surviving in fragments (Excerpta Constantiniana, Salmasiana)
edition: Roberto 2005 and Mariev, CFHB 47 (2008): both in copyright. Müller FHG IV–V and de Boor, Excerpta de insidiis 1905: public domain
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia (Иоанн Антиохийский (историк)) mentions only Mariev's English. A Russian search found no translation. Small excerpts in the Свод... are possible but unverified
en_evidence: Mariev 2008, 'recensuit anglice vertit' (ÖAW catalogue). Reviewed in BMCR 2009.12.06
value: Lost material on the Republic and Empire (from Dio, Eutropius, Priscus) and unique 5th-century western events such as the sack of 455. The Roberto–Mariev attribution dispute suits a transparent, multi-model apparatus.
ai_feasibility: Medium: easy Greek, but attribution and two rival editions need care. Use public-domain texts unless permission is obtained
pilot_unit: Fragments on the 5th-century West (Valentinian III, Aetius, 455), est. 5k words
